optimizedDescription.value: Defines @specd/guide architecture, standalone boundaries, errors, package assets, tests, README, and 1-indexed line semantics.

optimizedContext.value:
# Guide Conventions

## Rules

- Enforce hexagonal architecture:
  - `domain/`: business logic, entities, value objects, domain errors/services; MUST NOT import `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `application/`: use cases, queries, driven ports; depends only on `domain/`; MUST NOT import `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `infrastructure/`: driven adapters implementing application ports, including pre-bundled catalog storage and in-memory BM25 search via `minisearch`; depends on `domain/`, `application/`.
  - `composition/`: dependency-injection factories, composition root, unified `createGuideEngine()` facade.
  - `src/index.ts`, `src/public.ts`: re-export public facade, domain types, typed errors.
- `@specd/guide` MUST have no runtime dependency on `@specd/core`, `@specd/cli`, or `@specd/mcp`; remain self-contained for CI runners, client CLI binaries, MCP server processes; avoid SpecD kernel, AST parsers, delta engines, schema validators.
- Parse Markdown frontmatter/headings only at build time; no runtime AST parsing.
- Define error hierarchy under `domain/errors/` per `guide:errors`. All domain errors extend `SpecdGuideError`, implementing SpecD Error Contract (`specd = true`, `code: string`) without `@specd/core`. Application queries throw `GuideTopicNotFoundError` or `GuideSectionNotFoundError`; delivery adapters handle gracefully.
- `packages/guide/` supplies standard package assets: `package.json` (`@specd/guide`, `type: module`, `build`/`test`/`lint`, clean dependencies), monorepo-compatible `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, comprehensive `test/` coverage for domain models, queries, adapters, composition facade.
- `packages/guide/README.md` documents overview, motivation, zero-runtime-core-dependency design, hexagonal-layer diagram, pre-bundled topic catalog, `createGuideEngine()` quick start/query usage, and schemas for `GuideTopic`, `GuideSection`, `GuideOutline`, `GuideSearchHit`, `GuideSummary`.

## Constraints

- Zero runtime dependencies on `@specd/core`.
- Follow monorepo package conventions across all files/directories.
- All package line numbers MUST be 1-indexed.
